source: v3/decide/BASELINE.md 4, 7, 13 + REDESIGN_V2 5.8 layout row + ARCHITECTURE 5.2-5.5; RF and stack values wait for SIM-12 and V3-G3a

PWR_HIGH.why: BQ25570 boost CBC 230 mA / buck 185 mA; PV up to ~60 mA through Q14 and R130 (cold start 36-52 mW in R130, CALC_V3F 2); pack path BATT_P carries the U12 inrush ~0.3 A and the motor start <= 80 mA; VBUS 33 mA (U15); motor 30-80 mA on MOTOR_N / VBAT_IC (J17 + and D17 at VBAT_IC, next to C106). LBOOST / LBUCK loops as short as possible.

GND.why: solid ground planes; B.Cu and L5 void under the electrode plates; GND_A1 / GND_A2 are the guard conductors between BATT_P and NTC in strap root A (through FB2 / FB4).

PWR_LOW.why: nRF52832 decoupling / DC/DC nodes (Nordic reference layout); AVDD_ECG star from U3; VDD_DISP from U16 (<= 1 mA); V_O2 the O-2 supply (<= 25 uA); front light <= 8 mA.

RF_50R.structure: to be re-derived for the 6-layer 1.0 mm stack (SIM-12 re-run)
RF_50R.why: as V2-B; radiator geometry from V3-G3a.

ECG_PAIR.why: R-ECG-1: symmetric inputs, >= 8 mm from L1 / L2, the motor (J17, Q12, D17) and the display SPI / EXTCOMIN lines.

ECG_ELECTRODE.why: IEC 61000-4-2 entry nets before the 330 k chain; no ground or pour on B.Cu / L5 facing the plates.

MOHM_KEEPOUT.why: R-PMIC-1 as v1, the V2-B hold nodes, and [V3F] O2_G (10 MOhm / 100 nF hold of Q14), the O-2 chain taps (732 k / 162 k / 52.3 k: 1 nA of leakage = 0.05 mV), VB_DET (1 MOhm divider: also the D12A wake source), the button nodes (100 k / 1 MOhm).

NTC_SENSE.why: [V3F] pack NTC node shared by the BQ25170 TS (38 uA), the O-2 ladder (100 k) and the MCU AIN (1 M): route as a guarded analog trace from the root-A land (J5 / FB3) to U15, U19, U20, R116, R149, away from SPI, EXTCOMIN, motor and PWM lines; ISET / VSET of U15 short and quiet (ISET is the current-sense node).

XTAL.why: short, symmetric, ground guard; no copper under the SC-16S body (Seiko remark).

PPG_ANALOG.why: PD cathode node is a nA input crossing the board from the skin-face photodiode to the sky-side MAX86141: one via, guarded by PD_GND.

DISPLAY.why: [V3F] 3 V panel lines from U17 / U21 to the FPC land J13: short (edge rate <= 50 ns at the panel, LD-29Y03 p.22), >= 8 mm from the ECG inputs; EXTCOMIN 60 Hz is a coupling source for E3 (display lane 3.6).

SIGNAL.why: 0.10 / 0.10 mm (0.09 only in the WLCSP fan-out); via-in-pad under WLCSP / DSBGA inner balls.

rule_areas.name: PLATE_VOID
rules: B.Cu and L5 void under the two electrode plates except the plate-dot pads and the TMP117 thermal island
vias under the plates covered by mask and >= 1 mm from a dot opening
no via of a PWR_HIGH net or of VDD_1V8 under a plate: only GND and nets behind >= 100 kOhm (review R-14)
J8 (bare ENIG with VSTOR, VLED, VIN_DC, AVDD_ECG, VDD) and every other mask-free B.Cu feature >= 2 mm from the plate edges and from the dot openings (review R-14)
[V3F] the 8.6 mm motor cut-out sits between E1 and E2 (planning centre X 20.0, Y 25.4 mm, BASELINE 5.1): the plate outlines and the cut-out are fixed together in V3-G9

rule_areas.name: ELECTRODE_TEST_PADS
rules: bare pads on the electrode nets ahead of the 2 x 330 kOhm: >= 1 mm to copper of any net above 0.5 V (review R-14)

rule_areas.name: ROOT_A_ENTRY
rules: [V3F] land order along the root wall BATT_P (J3) | GND (J4) | NTC (J5) | GND (J10): pads 1.0 x 4.0 mm at 1.5 mm pitch (gap 0.5 mm), span 5.5 mm inside X 4.5-10.5 mm (BASELINE 1, 4, 7)
one 0402 link per conductor, next to its land (FB1-FB4); the strap tails are quarter-wave monopoles at 2.44 GHz (BASELINE 13.1)
BATT_P_A to every other net >= 0.5 mm; no third net between the J3 and J4 lands (a root short is the cell short of BASELINE 13.2; F1 sits in the pack)

rule_areas.name: ROOT_B_ENTRY
rules: [V3F] wing tail PV_W+ (J7) | GND (J9) with FB5 / FB6 at the lands; PV_W joins PV_NODE before RSH1 so INA_PV measures lid + wing

rule_areas.name: CONTACTS
rules: [V3F] J15 / J18 at the elbow-end corner under the rim pins (X 0.4-3.7, Y 20.2-31.6 mm; contact zone 15.7 mm from the antenna keep-out, BASELINE 1, 13.1)
D13 next to J15 (one via at most between the land and the TVS), then D14, then C130 at U15 IN
mating pin inner face >= 3.4 x 2.2 mm centred on each spring-finger land (rotation-neutral, BASELINE E-13); free height >= 1.60 mm at the fingers

rule_areas.name: TMP117_ISLAND
rules: thermal-via island under U10 down to B.Cu under a plate; isolated copper (not on an electrode net)

rule_areas.name: VREF_SAMP_100G
rules: VREF_SAMP >= 100 GOhm to every other node

rule_areas.name: PMIC_NO_POUR
rules: no pours / planes under the divider, CREF, MOhm hold-node and O-2 chain footprints

rule_areas.name: WLCSP_LIGHT
rules: bare-die / X2SON packages under the opaque lid or the opaque mask of the window: no direct light (photo-currents in nA nodes)
no line of sight from D10, from its light window, from the front-light film or from the SWD / lid-tail openings to U6, U8, U4, U5 (review R-06)

rule_areas.name: SC16S_NO_PATTERN
rules: no copper under the crystal body

rule_areas.name: ECG_NOISE_DISTANCE
rules: L1, L2, Q12 / D17 / J17 (motor), Q11 / J16 (front-light PWM), U17 / U21 / J13 (display lines) >= 8 mm from the ADS1291 inputs and the electrode networks

rule_areas.name: ANTENNA
rules: keep-out and radiator geometry from V3-G3a; ERM can and magnet >= 10 mm (planned 20.9 mm), contact pins 15.7 mm, rib insert, front-light tail (BASELINE 13.1)

rule_areas.name: LOW_PART_ZONE
rules: [V3F] under the display panel (board X 1-33, Y 6-20 mm): only parts with height_max_mm <= 0.70 (parts.json); tall parts (> 0.70 mm) outside it: U15 0.80, SW1 1.35, J11 / J15 / J18 1.50, D10 0.90, L1 / L2, the 0603 and 1206 parts (BASELINE 5.3, 7)

rule_areas.name: MOTOR_CUTOUT
rules: [V3F] 8.6 mm board cut-out under the PV band, planning centre X 20.0, Y 25.4 mm; J17 at its edge; Q12 / D17 within 5 mm of J17 (loop of the 30-80 mA motor current)
the narrow board strip beside the cut-out: routing and drop strength checked in V3-G1

rule_areas.name: BUTTON
rules: [V3F] SW1 at the hand-end board edge below E3, actuator toward the wall membrane (side actuated, C&K B-41); 1.35 mm tall: needs >= 1.50 mm free height at the edge (V3-G9)

rule_areas.name: EDGE_LED
rules: at the board edge facing the light window of the ring; light-tight pocket (review R-06)
lands = Kingbright's recommended pattern (1.4 x 0.9 mm, gap 1.0 mm), which is what the JLC footprint of C598214 has

rule_areas.name: RLIM_1206
rules: [V3F] R130 1206 250 mW carries the cold-start clamp current: 36 mW at 1 sun 25 C, 52 mW at 1.2 sun -10 C (BASELINE 11.5): copper for heat spreading

rule_areas.name: SPRING_TABS
rules: mating tab / pin >= 3.4 x 2.2 mm centred on the pad centre (contact at 0 and 180 deg)
tab underside 1.00 mm above the land in the closed unit, 0.70-1.30 mm over the whole tolerance chain (review R-04)

fixed_features_without_net.name: motor cut-out
fixed_features_without_net.where: 8.6 mm circle (+0.3 mm band), centre X 20.0, Y 25.4 mm
